parent.description: Config type instance that contains this config child.

inactivityLogoutPeriod.description: The period of inactivity before the user is automatically logged out. By default the users will not be logged out.

inactivityWarningPeriod.description:
The period of inactivity before the user is shown a warning message. By default the users will not be warned.

Only applicable when inactivityLogoutPeriod is greater than 0
